result.summary: The proposed plan is complete and aligned with the shared responsive terminal lifecycle.

checklist.description: Update the shared toolbar terminal sizing path to retain the last valid geometry when its host is hidden or has no measurable area and trigger a fresh fit when the dock is restored, resized, or moved into or out of fullscreen.

Use each valid visible measurement as the single source for resizing both the xterm renderer and its managed PTY so Agent terminal content reflows consistently across the full available rows and columns.

result.summary: Make the shared toolbar terminal sizing lifecycle ignore hidden or unmeasurable layouts and refit from the real visible area after minimize, restore, resize, and fullscreen transitions, so both the browser terminal and its Agent TUI use the full width available instead of retaining transient narrow dimensions.

checklist.evidence: terminalSize now rejects closed, disconnected, zero-content, and no-client-rect hosts; existing xterm geometry is left untouched, renderer creation is deferred until measurable, retained lastCols/lastRows seed session startup, and redraw/ResizeObserver/drag-complete scheduling refits after restore, resize, and fullscreen transitions.

resizeTerminalRenderer derives one valid visible size, applies that exact cols/rows pair to xterm, and only after renderer success schedules the same pair for the managed PTY resize API; VM and Chromium regressions assert renderer/backend equality.
